content_of_post_to_comment: Is there anyone here who actually writes? I mean… real essays, stories, ideas, not just growth metrics, follower counts, and engagement hacks. I’m genuinely asking. If you have something you’ve actually written, share it with me. I’d love to read it.
comment: There’s a difference between writing to be read and writing to be discovered. The strange thing is that the first often requires playing the second game. I wonder how many good essays remain invisible simply because their writers refuse to play it.
